rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an ordinary edible bean, bean plant, or generic bean-like seed.

example.english: This kind of bean can be eaten raw.
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 dau6 ho2 ji5 saang1 sik6

rows.note: Use this specifically for an edible green bean pod, especially the long pod commonly sold and cooked in Hong Kong.

example.english: I bought a catty of bean pods today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 gan1 dau6 gok3

rows.note: Use this instead of the general 豆 when the bean-like seed is specifically a coffee bean.

example.english: This coffee bean smells great after being ground.
example.traditional: 呢粒咖啡豆磨咗之後好香。
example.jyutping: ni1 nap1 gaa3 fe1 dau6 mo4 zo2 zi1 hau6 hou2 hoeng1
